title: Collection entry metadata (meta.json)
description: Everything about a collection entry that is not the manifest: who verified it, when, on what, and what the site previews. Hand-written — unlike game.schema.json, this file has no upstream. The contract is collection/README.md; this is its enforceable half.

title.description: Human-readable game name — the feed's `title`, the bar copy on the site.

author.description: Who verified the entry, as a GitHub handle.

verifiedAt.description: The date somebody actually ran the manifest, not the commit date. Published as the feed's `updatedAt`. Calendar date only, YYYY-MM-DD: `format: date` is a no-op in Ajv without ajv-formats, so the shape is a pattern.

tested.description: The systems the manifest was run on, in Node's own process.platform vocabulary (darwin is macOS) — not the launcher's HostPlatform words, which meta.json never reaches. Not published to the feed; it is here for whoever reads the repository.

steamAppId.description: The game's Steam app id, when it has one.

notes.description: Anything a user needs to know before dropping this on a card.

preview.description: What the site shows for the entry, listed explicitly. Paths are relative to the entry directory. Optional: without it the feed generator guesses one from the manifest.
